text: I've been on hold for 40 minutes so I'm messaging. My daughter is 2. She's had runny poo today but she's drinking fine and weeing normally, so I wasn't worried about that bit. But now she's got these little dark reddish purple dots on her tummy and legs. I pressed a glass on them like you're meant to and I don't think they went away, they're still there through the glass. And she looks really pale, kind of patchy and mottled, I think? Not her normal colour anyway. Someone needs to actually look at this.
